segments.mil7.4.7:1.1: “Bhante nāgasena,‘candassa pañca aṅgāni gahetabbānī’ti yaṃ vadesi, katamāni tāni pañca aṅgāni gahetabbānī”ti?
segments.mil7.4.7:1.2: “Yathā, mahārāja, cando sukkapakkhe udayanto uttaruttariṃ vaḍḍhati, evameva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yogāvacarena ācārasīlaguṇavattappaṭipattiyā āgamādhigame paṭisallāne satipaṭṭhāne indriyesu guttadvāratāya bhojane mattaññutāya jāgariyānuyoge uttaruttariṃ vaḍḍhitabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.4.7:1.4: Idaṃ, mahārāja, candassa paṭhamaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.4.7:2.1: “Puna caparaṃ, mahārāja, cando uḷārādhipati, evameva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yogāvacarena uḷārena chandādhipatinā bhavitabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.4.7:2.3: Idaṃ, mahārāja, candassa dutiyaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.4.7:3.1: “Puna caparaṃ, mahārāja, cando nisāya carati, evameva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yogāvacarena pavivittena bhavitabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.4.7:3.3: Idaṃ, mahārāja, candassa tatiyaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.4.7:4.1: “Puna caparaṃ, mahārāja, cando vimānaketu, evameva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yogāvacarena sīlaketunā bhavitabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.4.7:4.3: Idaṃ, mahārāja, candassa catutthaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.4.7:5.1: “Puna caparaṃ, mahārāja, cando āyācitapatthito udeti, evameva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yogāvacarena āyācitapatthitena kulāni upasaṅkamitabbāni.
segments.mil7.4.7:5.3: Idaṃ, mahārāja, candassa pañcamaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.4.7:5.4: Bhāsitampetaṃ, mahārāja, bhagavatā devātidevena saṃyuttanikāyavare ‘candūpamā, bhikkhave, kulāni upasaṅkamatha, apakasseva kāyaṃ apakassa cittaṃ niccanavakā kulesu appagabbhā’”ti [appagabbāti (ka.) saṃ. ni.2.146].
